claims.text: Atletico Madrid have agreed a £34.1m deal for Tottenham defender Cristian Romero.
Galatasaray have submitted a bid, reportedly £38m, for Arsenal winger Gabriel Martinelli.
Inter are in advanced talks to sign Spurs full-back Djed Spence.
Hull City have signed central defenders Mendy and Herrington.
Araujo has joined Liverpool from Barcelona.
Man City have rejected a fresh Barcelona bid for Rodri.

digest_md:
**What matters for FPL:**

- Atletico Madrid have agreed a £34.1m deal for Tottenham defender Cristian Romero. — [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cy8e2vx2l30o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/aug/12/atletico-madrid-agree-deal-tottenham-cristian-romero)
- Galatasaray have submitted a bid, reportedly £38m, for Arsenal winger Gabriel Martinelli. _(rumoured)_ — [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cwy42p7r00zo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/aug/13/football-transfer-rumour-mill-galatasaray-38m-arsenal-gabriel-martinelli)
- Inter are in advanced talks to sign Spurs full-back Djed Spence. _(rumoured)_ — [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cvgxz9xd95zo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- Hull City have signed central defenders Mendy and Herrington. — [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/clyjp48lvp2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- Araujo has joined Liverpool from Barcelona. — [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c4gx5w7egvwo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- Man City have rejected a fresh Barcelona bid for Rodri. — [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13567985/rodri-transfer-news-man-city-reject-55m-bid-from-barcelona-for-world-cup-winning-midfielder), [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/aug/13/manchester-city-barcelona-rodri-chelsea-enzo-fernandez)
